sections.heading: What It Is
sections.body:
- Acidity mein pet ka pitta dosha badh jata hai aur digestive acid zyada ya galat
  time par banta hai.
- Isse seene aur pet mein jalan, khatti dakar, aur khatta pani mooh tak aana
  jaisa lagta hai.
- Ayurveda isko "amlapitta" kehta hai — teekha aur garam pitta jab apni jagah se
  bahar behta hai.

sections.heading: Root Cause
sections.body:
- Khana bahut late karna ya meal skip karna, jisse khali pet mein acid banta rahe.
- Khali pet chai ya coffee, aur din bhar zyada chai peena.
- Zyada mirchi, achaar, imli, tala hua aur bahut khatta khana.
- Khane ke turant baad let jaana ya so jaana.
- Stress, gussa, aur jaldi-jaldi khana — pitta seedha badhta hai.
- Raat ko bahut late aur bhari dinner.

sections.heading: Changes To Make
sections.body:
- Do: har roz fix time par khana, chhote-chhote meals, aaram se chaba kar khana.
- Do: dinner 8 baje se pehle aur halka rakhein.
- Do: din bhar thoda-thoda saada paani piyein.
- Avoid: khane ke 2 ghante ke andar letna ya sona.
- Avoid: khali pet chai/coffee aur khali pet mirchi wala khana.
- Avoid: gussa ya tension mein khana khana.

sections.heading: Food Chart
sections.body:
**Eat:** moong dal, khichdi, chawal, lauki, tori, kheera, coconut water, kela,
meethe fal (papita, anaar), thoda ghee, chaas, saunf, dhaniya, elaichi, thanda
doodh.

**Avoid:** mirchi, laal mirch, achaar, imli, vinegar, zyada tamatar, khali pet
chai/coffee, raat ko dahi, alcohol, deep-fried aur bahut namkeen packet food.

sections.heading: Daily Routine
sections.body:
- Subah: uthte hi ek glass saada ya halka garam paani, phir 15–20 minute yoga.
- Nashta: 8–9 baje tak, halka aur garam (poha, upma, daliya).
- Dopahar: sabse bada meal 12–2 ke beech, jab digestion sabse strong hota hai.
- Shaam: 5 baje ke baad heavy chai/coffee band.
- Raat: halka dinner 8 baje se pehle, phir 10 minute slow walk.
- Sone se pehle: 10:30 tak so jaayein, screen kam karein.

sections.heading: Yoga & Breathing
sections.body:
- Asanas: Vajrasana (khane ke baad 5–10 minute), Pawanmuktasana, halka
  Bhujangasana, Ushtrasana (aaram se), Setu Bandhasana.
- Pranayama: Shitali aur Sheetkari (thandak dete hain), slow deep belly breathing,
  Anulom Vilom.
- Avoid: flare-up ke time Kapalbhati aur Bhastrika, khane ke turant baad strong
  twists aur inversions.

sections.heading: Home Remedies
sections.body:
- Sirf kitchen ki cheezein — saunf aur dhaniya bhiga kar uska paani.
- Khane ke baad thodi saunf chabana.
- Thanda (garam nahi) doodh ya coconut water jalan ke waqt.
- Raat bhar bhige hue kishmish ya munakka subah khana.
- Kabhi bhi koi tablet, syrup, churna brand ya dosage khud se na lein.

sections.heading: When To See A Doctor
sections.body:
- Ulti mein khoon, ya kaala/tar jaisa stool.
- Nigalne mein dikkat ya khana atakne jaisa lagna.
- Bina wajah weight kam hona ya bhookh bilkul khatam hona.
- Chest pain jo haath, gale ya jabde tak jaaye, ya saans phoolne ke saath ho —
  yeh emergency ho sakta hai, turant hospital jaayein.
- Ek mahine se zyada acidity jo in changes se bhi theek na ho.

sections.heading: When To See A Doctor

- Chehre par tezi se failne wale daane, ya mawad bhare.

- Acne 2–3 mahine ghar ke upay se bhi na sudhre.
- Achanak acne shuru ho jaaye badi umar mein.
- Bukhar ya sujan ke saath muhase.
- Muhase se mann bahut kharab ho raha ho ya bahar jaana band ho gaya ho — yeh

sections.heading: Root Cause
sections.body:
- Galat posture — jhuk kar baithna, phone dekhte hue gardan/kamar mod'na.
- Ghanton tak ek hi jagah baithna, khaas kar kursi par bina support ke.
- Core aur kamar ki muscles ka kamzor hona.
- Bhaari wajan galat tarike se uthana (kamar se jhuk kar, ghutne se nahi).
- Weight zyada hona, khaas kar pet ka.
- Bahut naram gadda ya galat takiya.
- Thandi hawa, AC seedha kamar par.
- Neend aur stress ki kami — muscles kas jaati hain.
- Kabz aur gas — kamar par dabav badhta hai.
- Ladies mein period, pregnancy aur delivery ke baad.

sections.heading: Changes To Make
sections.body:
- Do: har 30–45 minute baad uth kar 2 minute chalein.
- Do: kursi par kamar seedhi, pair zameen par, screen aankh ki height par.
- Do: wajan uthate waqt ghutne modein, kamar nahi.
- Do: garam sikaai roz — dard aur akadan dono kam hote hain.
- Do: core aur kamar ki muscles majboot karein — yeh asli permanent ilaaj hai.
- Do: gadda medium-firm rakhein; peeth ke bal soyein to ghutne ke neeche takiya,

- Avoid: bed rest lambe time tak — 1–2 din se zyada aaram dard badhata hai.
- Avoid: kamar se jhuk kar wajan uthana, aur ek taraf bhaari bag latkana.
- Avoid: bahut naram sofa aur gadda.
- Avoid: seedha AC ya thandi hawa kamar par.

sections.heading: Home Remedies

- Til ya sarson tel halka garam karke kamar par 10 minute halki maalish.
- Uske baad garam paani ki bottle se 10–15 minute sikaai.
- Haldi wala garam doodh raat ko.
- Adrak ki chai.
- Methi ke daane bhigo kar subah.

- Dono pairon mein kamzori ya sunnpan.
- Kamar dard ke saath bukhar, ya bina wajah weight girna.
- Girne ya chot lagne ke baad ka kamar dard.
- Dard jo pair mein ghutne se neeche tak jaaye aur badhta jaaye.
- Raat ko aaram karte waqt bhi dard, ya dard se neend khul jaana.
- Pair ghaseetne lage ya chappal pair se girne lage.
- 6 hafte se zyada dard jo in upayon se na sudhre.
- 50 ki umar ke baad naya kamar dard, ya cancer/osteoporosis ki history ho.
- Test karwa lein: vitamin D, calcium aur zaroorat par X-ray/MRI — yeh doctor

sections.heading: What It Is
sections.body:
- **Ashwagandha** — jad wali jadi buti. Stress, thakan aur kamzori ke liye
  Ayurveda mein sabse zyada istemaal hoti hai. Vata aur kapha ko shaant karti hai.
- **Triphala** — teen fal ka mel: amla, haritaki (harad) aur bibhitaki (baheda).
  Pet saaf rakhne aur digestion ke liye.
- **Brahmi** — dimaag ki jadi buti. Yaadasht, dhyan aur mann ki shaanti ke liye.
- **Tulsi** — ghar ka sabse aam paudha. Sardi-khaansi, saans aur immunity ke liye.
- **Amla** — vitamin C ka sabse achha natural source. Baal, skin, aankh aur
  immunity, teenon ke liye.
- **Giloy (Guduchi)** — bel jaisi jadi buti. Immunity aur baar-baar bukhar ke
  liye istemaal hoti hai.

sections.heading: Root Cause
sections.body:
- Ayurveda mein har jadi buti kisi dosha ke bigadne par di jaati hai, sabko nahi.
- **Vata bigda ho** (sookhapan, thakan, ghabrahat, neend na aana): ashwagandha,
  brahmi.
- **Pitta bigda ho** (garmi, acidity, jalan, muhase): amla, giloy, brahmi.
- **Kapha bigda ho** (bhaaripan, susti, balgam, weight): triphala, tulsi.
- Isliye "sabke liye ek hi herb" wali soch galat hai — jo ek ke liye achha hai
  wo doosre ke liye ulta pad sakta hai.

sections.heading: Changes To Make
sections.body:
- Do: ek waqt par ek hi jadi buti se shuruaat karein, taaki pata chale kya suit
  kar raha hai.
- Do: pehle khana, neend aur routine theek karein — jadi buti unki jagah nahi leti.
- Do: taza aur bharosemand quality lein.
- Do: pregnancy, breastfeeding, ya koi dawa chal rahi ho to pehle doctor se poochein.
- Avoid: kai herbs ek saath, lambe time tak, bina kisi salah ke.
- Avoid: online "ayurvedic" capsule aur powder jinme kya mila hai pata na ho —
  kai mein heavy metal aur steroid mile hote hain.
- Avoid: apni chal rahi dawa (BP, sugar, thyroid) inke bharose band karna.

sections.heading: Food Chart
sections.body:
**Eat (khaane ka aam tareeka):** amla — taza fal, juice ya subah khali pet.
Tulsi — 4–5 patte subah, ya chai mein. Ashwagandha — raat ko garam doodh ke
saath. Triphala — raat ko garam paani ke saath. Brahmi — subah doodh ya paani
ke saath. Giloy — uska paani ya kadha, mausam badalne par.

**Avoid:** khali pet bahut garam herbs (ashwagandha, giloy) agar acidity rehti
ho. Amla ko doodh ke saath nahi. Bahut zyada matra — jyada lene se fayda nahi,
nuksaan hota hai. Alcohol ke saath koi bhi herb.

sections.heading: Daily Routine
sections.body:
- Subah khali pet: amla (taza ya juice), ya tulsi ke 4–5 patte.
- Subah: brahmi, agar padhai ya dhyan ke liye le rahe hain.
- Din mein: tulsi-adrak ki chai.
- Mausam badalne par: giloy ka paani, kuch dino ke liye — poore saal nahi.
- Raat khane ke baad: ashwagandha garam doodh ke saath (neend aur thakan ke liye).
- Sone se pehle: triphala garam paani ke saath (agar kabz rehti ho).
- Ek herb ko 4–6 hafte lein, phir break — Ayurveda mein bhi lagatar chalana
  sahi nahi maana jata.

sections.heading: Yoga & Breathing
sections.body:
- Jadi buti akeli kaam nahi karti — yoga aur pranayama ke saath hi asli fayda hai.
- Ashwagandha ke saath: Shavasana, Yoga Nidra, Anulom Vilom (stress ke liye).
- Brahmi ke saath: Bhramari, meditation, Sarvangasana (dimaag ke liye).
- Triphala ke saath: Pawanmuktasana, Malasana, Bhujangasana (pet ke liye).
- Tulsi aur giloy ke saath: Kapalbhati, Bhastrika, Ujjayi (saans aur immunity).
- Amla ke saath: Surya Namaskar aur Sarvangasana (skin aur baal ke liye).

sections.heading: Home Remedies
sections.body:
- **Amla:** roz 1 taza amla, ya 20 ml juice paani ke saath subah.
- **Tulsi:** 4–5 patte subah khali pet chabana, ya adrak-kali mirch ke saath chai.
- **Ashwagandha:** raat ko garam doodh mein, thakan aur neend ke liye.
- **Triphala:** raat ko garam paani ke saath, kabz ke liye.
- **Brahmi:** subah doodh ke saath, ya brahmi ke patte.
- **Giloy:** uske tane ka paani ubaal kar, mausam badalne par kuch din.
- **Kisi bhi herb ki matra, brand ya dosage yahan nahi di ja sakti** — yeh umar,
  halat aur chal rahi dawa par nirbhar karta hai, aur ise Ayurveda doctor
  (Vaidya) hi decide kar sakta hai.

sections.heading: When To See A Doctor
sections.body:
- **Ashwagandha na lein** agar: pregnancy ho, thyroid tez ho (hyperthyroid), ya
  koi autoimmune bimari ho — yeh use badha sakti hai.
- **Giloy na lein** lambe time tak — kuch logon mein liver ko nuksaan ke mamle
  saamne aaye hain. Autoimmune bimari mein bhi bachein.
- **Triphala na lein** pregnancy mein, ya agar loose motions rehte hon.
- **Amla dhyan se** agar khoon patla karne ki dawa chal rahi ho.
- **Brahmi** thyroid ki dawa ka asar badal sakti hai.
- Koi bhi herb lene ke baad daane, khujli, ulti, pet dard ya peeli aankhein —
  turant band karein aur doctor ko dikhayein.
- Sugar, BP ya thyroid ki dawa chal rahi ho to koi bhi herb shuru karne se pehle
  doctor ko zaroor batayein — yeh dawa ka asar badha ya ghata sakti hain.
- Bachchon aur pregnancy mein koi bhi jadi buti bina doctor ki salah ke nahi.
- Yaad rakhein: "natural" ka matlab "hamesha safe" nahi hota.

sections.body:
- Autoimmune wajah (Hashimoto ya Graves) — sabse aam, jisme body apni hi gland

- Iodine ki kami ya bahut zyada iodine.
- Lagatar stress aur neend ki kami.
- Delivery ke baad ka samay.

sections.heading: Home Remedies
sections.body:
- Ashwagandha wala garam doodh raat ko — Ayurveda mein taakat ke liye khaas.
- Roz 5–6 bhige badam aur 2 khajoor subah khali pet.
- Kela + doodh + khajoor ka shake.
- Har meal mein 1 chammach ghee.
- Til aur gud ke laddu.
- Kishmish aur anjeer raat bhar bhigo kar subah.
- Roz til tel ki poore sharir maalish.
- Koi weight-gain powder, protein brand ya steroid khud se na lein — steroid se
  weight badhta hai par liver aur hormone barbaad ho jaate hain.

sections.heading: When To See A Doctor
sections.body:
- Bina koshish ke weight tezi se kam ho raha ho — yeh hamesha check karwana chahiye.
- Weight kam hone ke saath bukhar, raat ko paseena, ya lagatar khaansi (TB ki jaanch).
- Bahut bhookh lagne ke bawajood weight girna, saath mein pyaas aur baar-baar
  urine (diabetes ki jaanch).
- Dil tez dhadakna, haath kaapna aur garmi lagna (thyroid tez hone ka sign).
- Lagatar loose motions ya pet dard.
- Khoon ki kami ke signs: bahut peela dikhna, chakkar, saans phoolna.
- Khana khane se dar lagna ya jaan bujh kar na khana — iske liye proper madad lein.
- Thyroid, sugar, khoon ki kami, vitamin B12 aur celiac ka test karwa lein.

summary: Karshya mein sharir ke dhatu (tissue) kam ban paate hain — body dubli, kamzor aur jaldi thakne wali ho jaati hai. Ayurveda mein iski jad badha hua vata aur kamzor absorption hai: khana jaata toh hai, par body use lagta nahi. Isliye sirf "zyada khao" kaam nahi karta — pehle digestion aur absorption theek karna padta hai.

sections.heading: What It Is
sections.body:
- Sthaulya mein kapha dosha aur "meda dhatu" (body fat) badh jaate hain, aur
  digestion ki aag (agni) dheemi pad jaati hai.
- Ayurveda ka nazariya: yeh sirf zyada khane ka nateeja nahi hai — dheemi agni
  aur inactive lifestyle isse banaye rakhte hain.
- Isliye ilaaj mein khana kam karna nahi, balki agni tez karna aur movement
  badhana pehle aata hai.

sections.heading: Root Cause
sections.body:
- Din bhar baithe rehna aur bilkul physical activity na hona.
- Refined carbs: cheeni, maida, cold drinks, bakery, packet snacks.
- Bina bhookh ke khana aur baar-baar snacking.
- Raat ko late aur bhaari dinner, phir turant so jaana.
- Neend puri na hona — bhookh ke hormone seedha bigadte hain.
- Stress — cortisol pet par fat jama karta hai.
- Din mein sona, khaas kar khane ke baad (Ayurveda mein kapha badhane ka sabse
  bada karan).
- Thyroid ki kami, PCOS, ya kuch dawaiyan bhi wajah ho sakti hain.

sections.heading: Changes To Make
sections.body:
- Do: roz 45 minute movement — brisk walk, strength training ya yoga.
- Do: sabse bada meal dopahar mein, dinner sabse halka.
- Do: har meal mein protein aur fibre — bhookh apne aap control hoti hai.
- Do: 7–8 ghante neend.
- Do: dheere-dheere target rakhein — mahine mein 2–3 kg se zyada nahi.
- Avoid: cheeni, cold drink, packet juice, maida, fried aur fast food.
- Avoid: khane ke baad din mein sona.
- Avoid: crash diet aur bhookhe rehna — agni aur kamzor hoti hai, weight wapas
  aata hai.

sections.heading: Food Chart
sections.body:
**Eat:** moong dal, jau (barley), bajra, ragi, oats, hari sabziyan, lauki,
tori, karela, methi, salad khane se pehle, chaas, paneer, anda, machhli,
alsi aur kaddu ke beej, amla, adrak, kali mirch, dalchini, haldi, jeera-dhaniya
paani, halka garam paani din bhar.

**Avoid:** cheeni aur mithai, cold drinks aur packet juice, maida, white bread,
biscuit-cake, fried aur fast food, zyada chawal aur aloo, cheese aur bahut
zyada dairy, alcohol, packet snacks, raat ko heavy khana.

sections.heading: Daily Routine
sections.body:
- Subah: uthte hi halka garam paani, nimbu ya shahad ke saath.
- Subah: 45 minute exercise — khali pet walk sabse achhi.
- Nashta: protein wala (moong chilla, anda, paneer) — bread/cereal nahi.
- Dopahar 12–2: sabse bada meal, salad pehle khaayein.
- Shaam: chaas ya nuts ka chhota snack, chai bina cheeni.
- Raat: sabse halka dinner 7–8 baje tak — soup, sabzi, dal.
- Dinner ke baad: 15 minute walk, phir 2 ghante baad hi sona.
- Din mein sona nahi.

sections.heading: Yoga & Breathing
sections.body:
- Asanas: Surya Namaskar (roz 12 round, dheere badhayein), Trikonasana,
  Virabhadrasana, Utkatasana (chair pose), Naukasana, Dhanurasana,
  Bhujangasana, Plank, Setu Bandhasana.
- Kapha ke liye tez aur flowing practice chahiye — dheemi restorative nahi.
- Pranayama: Kapalbhati (khali pet, roz badhayein), Bhastrika, Anulom Vilom,
  Agnisar kriya.
- Roz kam se kam 30–45 minute. Consistency se hi kaam banta hai.
- Ghutne ya kamar ki problem ho to pehle trainer ya doctor se poochein.

sections.heading: Home Remedies
sections.body:
- Subah khali pet halka garam paani nimbu ke saath.
- Methi ke daane raat bhar bhigo kar subah.
- Jeera-dhaniya-saunf ka paani din bhar sip karna.
- Khane se pehle salad ya soup — pet pehle bharta hai.
- Dalchini ka paani.
- Amla juice ya taza amla roz.
- Roz walk — koi bhi "fat cutter" isse zyada kaam nahi karta.
- Koi weight-loss tablet, powder, tea ya brand khud se na lein — yeh nuksaan
  karte hain.

sections.heading: When To See A Doctor
sections.body:
- Weight bina koshish ke tezi se badh raha ho.
- Saath mein bahut thakan, thand lagna, aur baal jhadna — thyroid test karwayein.
- Ladies mein weight ke saath irregular period aur chehre par baal — PCOS test.
- Gardan ya bagal ki skin kaali padna (insulin resistance ka sign).
- Kharraate ke saath raat mein saans ruk jaana.
- Chest pain, saans phoolna, ya pairon mein sujan.
- Ghutne ya kamar ka dard jo exercise rok raha ho.
- Weight ke saath sugar, BP aur cholesterol ka test zaroor karwa lein — inka
  proper ilaaj doctor hi karta hai.
